newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's govt paper volume rises to 184 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia's govt paper volume rises to 184 trln rbls.

text.p: The current volume of the government securities market rose to 184.23 trillion roubles on August 23 by face value from 181.76 trillion roubles on August 16, the central bank said on Monday.
The market value of issues in circulation rose to 162.88 trillion roubles on August 23 from 161.01 trillion roubles on August 16, the central bank said in a statement.

The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 141.74 trillion roubles from 139.88 trillion roubles and the value of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds was unchanged at 21.13 trillion roubles.
Unplaced paper for all issues rose to 20.58 trillion roubles by face value from 18.55 trillion roubles.
